marta: Quick heads-up — after the kernel-selector rollout at 01:12 UTC we're seeing p95 spike on /embed-rerank-prod.

marta: Observed: p95 420ms (was 185ms), p50 62ms, p99 980ms, QPS ~120. Avg tokens/request 64. Avg observed batch size ~3.2. KV cache hit rate dropped to 12% (baseline ~38%). :thinking_face:

devin: Any recent model config or dim change? high-dim embeddings increase memcpy + kernel perf.

marta: We rolled model v2.7 this morning which uses 1024-d vectors vs 768 before. Also kernel-selector started preferring new 'auto-gemm' path for some seq lengths.

anil: Can you paste the kernel selection breakdown and perf profile? I want kernel_call counts + kernel_latencies.

marta: PromQL snippets I ran:
```
sum by (kernel) (rate(inference_kernel_calls_total{route="/embed-rerank-prod"}[5m]))
sum by (kernel) (rate(inference_kernel_time_seconds_sum{route="/embed-rerank-prod"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/embed-rerank-prod"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Results (5m window): auto-gemm 65% calls, optimized-attn 30%, fallback-gemm 5%. auto-gemm p95 ~480ms, optimized-attn p95 ~190ms.

luca: auto-gemm suffering for 1024-d vectors on Ampere kernels — KV payloads ~3x larger, serialization + NVLink memcpy spikes. KV hit drop means more full forward runs.

marta: I also profiled GPU kernels — we saw increased memcpy H2D and D2H around batch boundaries and bigger CPU post-processing time (cosine norm + L2 normalization) up 2.1x.

anil: Two quick experiment ideas:
- rollback kernel-selector to prefer optimized-attn for seq <=128 (canary on 10% users)
- adaptive batching: increase max batch size to 16 when QPS > 80 and kv_hit < 20% to amortize memcpy overhead

luca: Also try changing KV serialization to float16 for storage (loss acceptable for rerank) — halves KV size and should raise hit effectiveness.

devin: Can we check per-route token-latency breakdown dashboard? need token decode vs kv-lookup vs kernel-exec vs memcpy buckets.

marta: Latest per-route breakdown (derived from our tracing): token_decode 8%, kv_lookup 22%, memcpy 28%, kernel_exec 38%, postproc 4%.

ops-bot: incident.alert: rerank-slo-drift triggered at 01:18 UTC — 1200 alerts in 10m

marta: Action plan:
1) anil to roll canary kernel-selector (10%) — target: 02:00 UTC — ETA 20m
2) luca to deploy adaptive-batching tweak to route config (max_batch 16, batch_wait_ms 8 -> 12) — ETA 02:10 UTC
3) devin to run KV F16 experiment on a shadow replica (data + perf) — ETA EOD
4) me to update dashboards: add kernel-level p50/p95, kv-hit by model-dim, batch-size distribution

anil: ack. I'll post canary results here. :rocket:

luca: starting PR for adaptive batching config, will link.

devin: I'll provision shadow and run f16 sampling, will post perf delta.

marta: thanks — ping me if alerts spike. :eyes:
